title: BlackyWhiteTierTagger
description: Displays player tiers from BlackyWhite community rankings
body:
# BlackyWhite TierTagger

BlackyWhite TierTagger is a modern client-side PvP utility mod that allows players to view BlackyWhite community tiers directly in Minecraft. Player rankings are displayed seamlessly above nametags and inside the tab list, making it easier to recognize skill levels during fights, practice sessions, and competitive gameplay.

The mod is designed to be lightweight, fast, and visually clean, using a monochrome-inspired style that fits naturally into the Minecraft UI without feeling intrusive. All ranking data is automatically synced from the BlackyWhite ranking system Website and cached locally for smoother performance.

## Features
- Displays BlackyWhite player tiers above nametags
- Integrated tier display inside the tab list
- Lightweight and optimized for PvP gameplay
- Automatic syncing with the BlackyWhite ranking database
- Local caching support for faster loading
- Clean black-and-white visual style
- Works on multiplayer servers without server-side installation

## Compatibility
- Fabric 1.21 – 1.21.1
- Requires Fabric API
- Compatible with most modern Minecraft clients

## Notes
This mod is completely client-side and safe to use on any server. Server owners do not need to install anything for the mod to function.
